global.meta_desc: Garima weds Mrinal · A wedding in the Kumaon hills
stay.header.banner_line2: EVERYTHING YOU NEED FOR THE TRIP
stay.travel.air_pantnagar: Pantnagar (PGH): The closest airport, about 70 km from Nainital. Regular flights connect Delhi and Pantnagar. Continue to Nainital by taxi.
stay.travel.air_delhi: New Delhi (DEL): Delhi offers the widest choice of flights. From Delhi, continue by train to Kathgodam or by road to Nainital.
stay.travel.train_kathgodam: Kathgodam (KGM): The nearest railway station. From there, Nainital is roughly 1–1.5 hours by road. Direct trains connect Kathgodam with Delhi.
stay.travel.cab_delhi_nainital: Delhi to Nainital: A scenic road journey (~6.5 to 8 hours / 300 km).
stay.travel.cab_hill_drive: Hill drive: The final 35 km climbs winding mountain roads. We highly recommend keeping motion-sickness tablets handy if you need them.
stay.arch.title:

stay
stay.arch.desc: Please let us know if you can make it by September 30 so we can finalize the rooms.
stay.arch.note: We are lovingly coordinating all accommodation and will share your specific hotel and room details directly with you.
stay.weather.title: Weather and Packing
stay.weather.weather_desc: Mountain Weather: Expect crisp, sunny days (~10–15°C) and chilly evenings dipping to a brisk ~2–7°C.
stay.weather.packing_desc: What to Pack: Warm layers, heavy woolens, a cozy evening coat or shawl, and comfortable walking shoes (Nainital is best explored on foot!).
stay.epilogue.quote: “In the hills, traditional woodcraft has always been the heart of a home, intricately carved to hold the warmth of the hearth and welcome dear ones.”
